last_verified_against: tools/router/pricing.js (PRICES), last reviewed 2026-08-03. Every priced model here was compared field-by-field against that SSOT on 2026-08-25; sonnet-4-6 and haiku-4-5 matched unchanged, opus-4-6 was filled from it (see its note). This is a re-verification date, NOT a re-pricing: no price was changed to a value that is not in the SSOT, and snapshot_version is unchanged so benchmark reproducibility holds.
routability_gate: packages/router/tests/decide-agent.test.ts (behavioural) + tools/cockpit/runner/precificavel-nao-rotavel.test.mjs (coverage). A model the SSOT prices WITHOUT a tier ('priceable, not routable') MAY now hold both a price here and a measured benchmark cell — those two conditions are what decide-agent.ts needs to rank it by TES — PROVIDED the engine's opt-in-only guard covers it (OPT_IN_ONLY_MODELS / isOptInOnly, decide-agent.ts). Until 2026-08-25 this was a tripwire and not a fix: the invariant was held by leaving the price out, i.e. by an omission, because decide-agent.ts was a frozen engine file with no allowlist entry. The owner authorised that entry on 2026-08-25 (CLAUDE.md, Wave 58 allowlist), the exclusion moved into the engine, and the gate changed question: from 'the data must stay incomplete' to 'every model that reaches the condition must be covered by the guard'.
freshness_gate: tools/cockpit/runner/frescura-de-precos.test.mjs — fails when last_verified_at is older than 30 days, when a price here contradicts the live SSOT, or when a model is marked pending while the SSOT can price it. This file feeds a COST router (packages/router/src/decide-agent.ts:40), so staleness here is a silent wrong decision, not a cosmetic lag.
notes: Standard (global) base-input + output pricing per MTok. No prompt caching, no batch, no fast-mode, no data-residency multipliers applied in this benchmark.

DEVIATION FROM DESIGN: BENCHMARK_DESIGN.md §17.2 and MASTER_PROMPT.md §4-A.2 hardcoded stale prices (Opus $15/$75 = deprecated Opus 4.1/4; Haiku $0.80/$4 = retired Haiku 3.5). Verified real 2026-05-27 prices used instead, per P7 (pricing.js is source of truth) and §4-A.2 ('alinhar primeiro'). Approved by Paulo at Phase 2. Logged in anomalies.md.

Opus 4.7 uses a NEW TOKENIZER (~35% more tokens for same text vs prior models). Cost is priced on actual API usage so it stays correct, but raw token-count comparisons across arms are NOT apples-to-apples — see limitations.
Ollama local models cost $0 (electricity not accounted).

Wave 58 Phase Seed (2026-06-12): added pending entries for models without in-repo price sources. These have input_per_mtok/output_per_mtok = null and pricing_status = 'pending'. computeCostMicros returns 0 (not NaN) for all pending models — the null guard in cost.ts already handles missing price entries. Prices must be supplied via 'mooter price-update' before these models can be accurately costed.

claude-opus-4-6.pricing_note: Filled 2026-08-25 from tools/router/pricing.js:46, where $5/$25 has stood since 2026-04-16 (commit 22ad1eea, 'verified Apr 2026 pricing'). The previous note here claimed 'No in-repo source for Opus 4.6 pricing as of 2026-06-12' — that was already false when written: the source predated it by two months. Consequence of the false pending: claude-opus-4-6 is the router's DEFAULT T3 model (pricing.js:155) and was excluded from decide-agent.ts's TES sort ('you cannot rank what you cannot price'), reachable only through the tier heuristic and flagged pending there (decide-agent.ts:165). No price was invented; it was copied from the in-repo SSOT.
claude-opus-4-6.pricing_no_lookahead: Checked because filling a dated snapshot from a later source would be look-ahead bias. It is not: $5/$25 entered pricing.js on 2026-04-16, which PRECEDES this snapshot's own date of 2026-05-27. The value was knowable at snapshot time; it was omitted, not unavailable. Same basis, too — this snapshot and pricing.js are both standard per-MTok input/output with no caching, batch or fast-mode multipliers, and this file's `source` field already declares it was cross-checked against pricing.js.

claude-fable-5.pricing_note: Price copied from the live SSOT, tools/router/pricing.js:66 ($10/$50, web-searched 2026-08-19 from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing). It was deliberately WITHHELD here until 2026-08-25: with no price, 'you cannot rank what you cannot price' (decide-agent.ts) was the only thing keeping T5 out of automatic routing. That guard is now real code — see routing_note.
claude-fable-5.tier_diverges_from_ssot: The SSOT (tools/router/pricing.js) deliberately gives claude-fable-5 NO tier; this snapshot keeps "tier": "T5". The divergence is DECLARED, not accidental, and deleting the field here was measured to be WORSE: decide-agent.ts defaults a tier-less model to "T2", so removing "T5" does not remove the tier — it swaps a true label for a false one, and surfaces begin reporting 'tier-heuristic:T2' about Fable. Since 2026-08-25 this field also DOES work: isOptInOnly() reads it as one of its two independent exclusion routes (the other being the named OPT_IN_ONLY_MODELS roster).
claude-fable-5.routing_note: OPT-IN ONLY (T5). Enforced in code since 2026-08-25 by decide-agent.ts (OPT_IN_ONLY_MODELS / isOptInOnly()), which filters this model out BEFORE the min_score and budget gates, so it never reaches the TES sort whatever its score or price. Reaching it requires naming it (force_model / @fable). Before that day the invariant was held by this entry's MISSING PRICE, i.e. by an omission: measured against the real engine, giving this entry the SSOT price made decideAgent({task_category:'reasoning.science'}) return claude-fable-5 with TES 3784 and nobody having typed @fable. Proof it no longer can: packages/router/tests/decide-agent.test.ts and tools/cockpit/runner/precificavel-nao-rotavel.test.mjs, which now seed exactly this priced state and assert the engine still refuses.
